Copy the spaces you (or this box) reach to ~/termag/spaces, read-only.

Usage: termag space sync [space]

With no space, every space you reach; copies of spaces you no longer reach are removed.
Files over 50 MiB, and those past 1 GiB or 5000 files in a space, are not copied (--json lists them).

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
